summary.text: Hubert D. Delany III was elected to the Connecticut General Assembly in 2022 to represent Stamford's 144th Assembly District, and is an Assistant Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: He is a U.S. Army sergeant who serves as a photojournalist, writer, mass communications specialist and paratrooper.
He is a Commissioner of the Stamford Patriotic and Special Events Commission and a member of American Legion Post 03.
